svg.title: Reference deployment topology: 22 clusters in two isolated stacks, with the components in each cluster, Git, Entra ID and the connections inside each stack
svg.text: Reference deployment topology: 22 clusters, two isolated stacks, Git as the only link

Four teams (payments, orders, search, ledger) × three environments (dv, te, pr), plus five platform clusters per stack (platform, fleet, choreo, build, observe). Every box inside a cluster is a component; second lines give the namespace or role.

np-argocd polls: platform tag · platform-nonprod · team-*/nonprod/
pr-argocd polls: platform tag · platform-pr · team-*/pr/
Connections inside each stack (same set in both stacks; nothing crosses between them)
1 Every cluster → OCM hub on <stack>-fleet · 443 outbound (AKS over the hybrid connection)
2 Team clusters, <stack>-build, <stack>-observe → OpenChoreo cluster gateway on <stack>-choreo · WSS 443 outbound
3 <stack>-platform → Supervisor API · 443 · creates and updates VKS clusters
4 <stack>-platform → Azure Resource Manager and Entra ID · 443 · CAPZ and ASO
5 <stack>-platform → private AKS API servers · 443 · CAPI node state
6 <stack>-platform → <stack>-fleet API · 6443 · Crossplane creates ManagedClusters, ManifestWorks; Argo CD installs the hub
7 <stack>-fleet → new cluster API · 443 / 6443 · one-time OCM import
8 <stack>-platform (Argo CD) → <stack>-choreo API · 6443 · OpenChoreo config and releases from Git
9 Every cluster → <stack>-observe · OTLP 4317 and remote-write · logs and metrics
10 Every cluster → Key Vault and ACR private endpoints · 443 · secrets and image pulls
12 Argo CD → Git · 443 · polling, so Git never connects into a stack
13 GitHub → <stack>-choreo webhook endpoint · 443 · build triggers (optional; GitHub ranges only)
Platform cluster (platform, fleet, choreo, build, observe)
